title: Ep 33 — Meta Launches Its Muse Agent, and the Pixel-Art Habit Tracker That Crossed a Thousand a Month
description: Meta launched Muse, a personal do-it-for-you AI agent running in a sandboxed environment, OpenAI shipped ChatGPT Images 2.5 and an internal model's disputed proof attempt on the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize problem, and US authorities named six Chinese AI labs running large-scale distillation campaigns against Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok. Plus a deep dive on Habit Pixel, a solo-built pixel-art habit tracker that crossed $1,000 MRR with around 900 subscribers, a correction on the Fundraising Regulator's prize-draw registration threshold for PlayFundWin (phased 10/15/20%, not a flat 20%), and a sixteenth consecutive quiet episode for EV-Partnerships' sports-venue charging gap.
